verdict.rationale: ByteAsk offers coarse action-level controls: an approval policy set via `--ask-for-approval`, and sandbox modes (read-only by default, `--sandbox workspace-write` to allow builds and writes). These let a lead limit what the agent does, but nothing shows per-tool or per-integration allow/deny control over external tools. Missing for 10: granular allowlisting of specific external tools and integrations (e.g. MCP servers, connectors, network access), team or admin-level policy enforcement, and independent corroboration.
